purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The WUP point is a settlement centroid, not parcel identity. The Bonn cadastre is city-wide, and NRW publishes an ALKIS parcel INSPIRE-WFS. Official metadata identifies AX_Flurstueck multipolygon data and EPSG:25832/EPSG:4258 download options. Direct network access from the shell failed DNS, and the web fetch rejected XML content type, so no schema response or point-bounded polygon was fetched. No sample retained and no runtime-enabled claim. No building or administrative-boundary layer used; no owner/address data retained.
registryAssessment: The City of Bonn states that its Liegenschaftskataster covers the entire municipal area and that parcel/building records are maintained in ALKIS. The official NRW INSPIRE-WFS catalog identifies the state download service for ALKIS cadastral parcels; official NRW metadata describes AX_Flurstueck as multipolygon data. Service identity and CRS are documented, but no actual point-bounded geometry response was fetched in this environment, so no sample or runtime-ready claim is made.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official City of Bonn page says the digital Liegenschaftskataster covers all Bonn and ALKIS maintains parcel and building records.
Official NRW WFS endpoint/catalog URL for INSPIRE ALKIS cadastral parcels. Direct GetCapabilities fetch was blocked by this environment's XML content-type handling.
Official GDI-NRW report identifies AX_Flurstueck (multipolygons) as ALKIS parcel data and lists the INSPIRE WFS.
Catalog record points to the official NRW INSPIRE-WFS and documents full downloads in EPSG:25832 and EPSG:4258, with Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero.

rootRuntimeAssessment.scope: 79 valid distinct NRW ALKIS cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Bonn WUP settlement locator. The existing shared North Rhine-Westphalia OGC API provider is reused. Complete offset paging, forced three-row pages, all 79 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 25 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32632 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Wider municipal completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and long-term key continuity remain unverified.
